wedding_details.body: Hi Jane Rider, Thank you — we have your wedding details, and one of our wedding professionals is building your day from them: every pickup, every vehicle. You'll have it, with a full quote, within one business day. No deposit, nothing locked in. REFERENCE <Q1> DATE Wedding date: Saturday, September 18, 2027 VENUE & CEREMONY Reception venue: The Oak Barn at Loyalty Ceremony at the same place?: No — two locations Ceremony location: St. John's Church WHO'S RIDING Who needs a ride?: Our guests, The wedding party Guests riding the shuttle: 105 Wedding party: 14 HOTELS Where is everyone staying?: Hampton Inn Leesburg; Lansdowne Resort TIMES Ceremony starts: 4:00 PM Venue requires everyone out by: 11:00 PM ANYTHING ELSE Anything else we should know?: Bridesmaids get ready at an Airbnb in Purcellville & need 2 cars. Plans still firming up? Open your details and change the guest count, the hotels or the times — we'll build from whatever is current: https://example.test/weddings/plan/<TOKEN lead=Jane Rider>/ Questions? Reply to this email or call (703) 555-0100. -- All Pro Charter Luxury charter & chauffeur service reservations@allprocharter.com · (703) 555-0100
